name: Apathy: Narugami Gakuen Nana Fushigi
original_name: アパシー 鳴神学園七不思議
source:
[url=/c116039]Sakagami Shuuichi[/url], a first-year student and member of the newspaper club, decides to listen to scary stories told by seven storytellers assembled by his upperclassmen to produce a feature on the school’s seven wonders for the school paper.

However, when he opened the door to the club room, there were only six people.

He went ahead and started the meeting on the school’s seven wonders without waiting on the seventh, unseen person, but a disturbing atmosphere filled the room.

The thought that he shouldn’t hold this meeting crossed his mind, but it was too late to turn back.

What kinds of stories will the six people share? And what awaits him at the end…?

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/11/horror-visual-novel-apathy-narugami-gakuen-nana-fushigi-announced-for-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
[url=/c116039]坂上修一[/url]是一名一年级学生，也是报纸俱乐部的成员，他决定听七名讲故事的人讲述的恐怖故事，这些讲故事的人是由他的高年级学生组成的，为校报制作一篇关于学校七大奇迹的专题报道。

然而，当他打开俱乐部房间的门时，却只有六个人。

他没有等到第七个看不见的人，就直接开始了关于学校七大奇迹的会议，但房间里却充满了令人不安的气氛。

他心里闪过不应该召开这次会议的念头，但已经来不及回头了。

六人又会分享怎样的故事呢？而最后等待着他的又是什么……？

[来自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/11/horror-visual-novel-apathy-narugami-gakuen-nana-fushigi-announced-for-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
